name: Achim
source:
A servant of the Shedre family who guards the graveyard of the Lake Manor. He takes good care of his axe. Although he is deeply loyal to the former head of the family, Delia, he does not take good care of the main Leroy family and the three heir candidates. He can speak both English and German.
